description: Pinned OMat24 validation-subset provenance (taskbook section 6.1). The subset is drawn ONLY from the official validation split, using the corrected 2024-12-20 files (fairchem issue #942), so none of these structures are model training data. Raw download caches live in an ignored local directory; the selected ~256-structure subset and this manifest are committed.

selection.rule: numpy default_rng(seed) shuffle of stratum indices, first per_stratum kept, sorted; selection script validation/science/scripts/omat_subset.py

sources.name: alpha-Na3PS4 tetragonal (geometry fixture)
